_about: Config of the dance programs (programs/dance-joints, programs/duo-scene, programs/dance-challenge).
The programs read the file named by the environment variable DANCE3D_CONFIG, else config.local.json next to this file.
The installer writes config.local.json; copy this file and fill in your own paths only if you install by hand.
Paths may start with ~ ; relative paths are relative to the folder of the config file. null = not installed (optional keys only).

_keys.python.motion: Python of the motion environment (ExMR, SAM 3 via ultralytics, MoGe, torch): runs the motion and 3D steps
_keys.python.comfy: Python of the ComfyUI environment: runs ComfyUI (the video model) and, by default, the local pages (gradio)
_keys.python.face: Python of the face environment (insightface, onnxruntime): the face check after the video model
_keys.python.ui: optional: another Python for the local pages; default python.comfy
_keys.blender: the Blender 4.5 program (renders the 3D studio and the mannequin guide)
_keys.comfyui: the ComfyUI program folder (the one with main.py); version 0.44 or newer (SCAIL-2 nodes are built in)
_keys.comfy_custom_nodes: list of ComfyUI custom node folders to load; SCAIL-2 GGUF files need ComfyUI-GGUF (city96)
_keys.comfy_pydeps: optional: folder with extra packages for ComfyUI only (e.g. the gguf package), if they are not in its environment
_keys.smplx: SMPLX_NEUTRAL.npz (or a folder holding it); default: models.motion/body_models/smplx/SMPLX_NEUTRAL.npz
_keys.models.comfy: ComfyUI models folder: unet/ (SCAIL-2 GGUF), diffusion_models/, loras/, text_encoders/, vae/, clip_vision/
_keys.models.h3: optional: MiniMax H3 models folder (only for --backend h3; the H3 licence excludes Korea, the US, the EU and the UK)
_keys.models.h3_extra: optional: folder with other H3 base models (two-dancer program --base singularity)
_keys.models.detector: YOLO11 person detector yolo11x.pt; default: models.motion/yolo/yolo11x.pt
_keys.models.motion: ExMR checkpoint folder (exmr/, body_models/, yolo/, sam-3d-body-dinov3/, hamer/, sapiens2/, rtmw/), see ExMR docs/INSTALL.md
_keys.models.face: InsightFace models folder (buffalo_l.zip or models/buffalo_l, inswapper_128.onnx)
_keys.models.describer: optional: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct folder; writes one sentence about the character picture for the video model
_keys.pydeps: optional: folder with extra packages for the motion tools (put first on PYTHONPATH of the motion steps)
_keys.python_headers: optional: folder holding Python.h, only if the system has no python3-dev (Triton compiles a helper)
_keys.yt_dlp: optional: the yt-dlp program for YouTube links in dance-joints; default: yt-dlp on PATH
_keys.runs_dir: folder in which every run gets its own dated folder (frames, logs, caches: tens of GB per run)
_keys.results_dir: folder in which finished results are saved, one folder per run
_keys.vram_gb: "auto" (read the graphics card) or the card's memory in GB; picks the SCAIL-2 tier (programs/duo-scene/scail_tiers.py)
_keys.gpu_helper: optional: a GPU lease helper (acquire/renew/release/job-init/artifact-register); null = use the visible GPU
_keys.managed_jobs: optional, default false: true = run folders are made and registered by gpu_helper job-init / artifact-register
